data: NVIDIA's operating income was about $4.224 billion in fiscal 2023 (year ended January 29, 2023) and about $81.453 billion in fiscal 2025 (year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of roughly $77.2 billion, or about 1,828%, meaning operating income grew nearly 19-fold over the two years. The jump reflects surging data center demand for AI accelerators, with revenue rising from $26.97 billion in fiscal 2023 to $130.5 billion in fiscal 2025, alongside a much higher operating margin of roughly 62% versus about 16% in fiscal 2023, when results were weighed down by inventory charges and a $1.35 billion acquisition termination cost related to Arm.
